input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 clears the fallback and in substance nearly all of the preferred checklist. 19.1 warrants Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and that Services and Deliverables materially conform to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a ninety-day Deliverable conformance warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance and warrants Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term (well beyond the 30-day services floor and, for the hosted software, longer than the preferred 12 months); 19.3 adds malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties; and 19.4 supplies the full remedy ladder of re-performance/repair/replacement followed by termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. 19.5 confirms no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so the disclaimer does not swallow the warranty. The only preferred sub-element short of the mark is that non-hosted Deliverables carry 90 days rather than 12 months; that is a minor gap noted here rather than redlined, since the clause otherwise sits at or above the fallback with the same remedies.
